segments.title: A shellfish rode on a seal's FACE
segments.say: A shellfish hitched a ride on a seal's face. It clamped onto its whiskers.

segments.title: It was a cockle
segments.say: It was a cockle, a small clam-like shellfish.

segments.title: Spotted in France
segments.say: Scientists spotted it on a harbour seal in France.

segments.title: Normally? A few cm
segments.say: An adult cockle normally moves just a few centimeters in its whole life.

segments.title: On a seal? Dozens of km
segments.say: Riding a seal, it could travel dozens of kilometers. That's a scientist's estimate.

segments.title: Source: Aquatic Mammals
segments.say: The study is in the journal Aquatic Mammals.
Follow for Weird Animal number 29 tomorrow.
